surface: plate_core.release / gh plate release cut|finalize / release.yml
summary: Require merge-commit Release PRs to main; detect squash-merged releases and print admin recovery.
migration_impact: Adopters should merge Release PRs with a merge commit (not squash). After upgrading plate-core, `gh plate release cut` and finalize print merge-method guidance; finalize suggests `gh plate release finalize <ver> --force-hard-reset --apply` when squash is detected.
agent_notes: Release PRs to main: `gh pr merge <N> --merge` only. If fast-forward fails with squash_merged_suspected, run the printed recovery command with maintainer approval. Optionally restrict merge methods on main in Settings → Rules (recommendation only).
